nodes.label: laptop memory - the 2026-07-22 v1 adversarial panel verdicts

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Method: four adversarial scouts (math, physics, engineering, logic) produced a merged taxonomy of 13 review types, then tier A ran five grounded specialists - scale-commensurability, statistical stop rules, Neo4j contracts, effective-configuration/vacuity, and canon fidelity - each grounding in primary sources, live probes or full replays before reviewing, at roughly 1M tokens. The panel worked: high convergence, real derivations, and several of the orchestrating agent's own claims overturned

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Verdicts, all grounded and replayed on real artifacts. 1 The curve-walk stop rule must not ship as the K-decider: exact false-stop 14.6% at the n=3 warmup with 31% of real stops happening there; the first-gap transient changes 46/100 stop decisions; a permutation test shuffling each chain's gaps gives 60.1 +/- 4.1 stops against 67 real, so the statistic carries almost no order information; measured cost kept-K recall 0.5058 vs 0.7464 at kept-50; and two different CoachForce questions produced the IDENTICAL chain and identical K=5. No spacing-based rule is calibratable on these chains, median 9 events. 2 The value system is an ordinal rank staircase, not a distance system: support = m(rank)/d^2 with m = 4/3/2/1 by pool-relative rank, a built-in door prior of about 12.2:4.9:1 scope:desc:tag at equal rank and distance, and flat normalization erasing absolute proximity. 3 The liveness matrix: flat det = desc-kNN (67% of kept value) + product scope (32%) + ONE tag (~1%), widening 0/100, cross-part summation vacuous; flat haiku is a DIFFERENT retriever with the tag door dominant at 70% of value. 4 Neo4j contracts pinned live: index score and vector.similarity.cosine are both (1+cos)/2, so support-side distances are half-scale while dendrogram heights are full-scale; ANN recall@64 = 61-63/64; the 1e-6 floor is unreachable. 5 Three canon conflicts requiring USER decisions, not agent calls: the no-numbers rule against the pass-2 interpreter emitting 0.0-1.0 facet scores; the no-answer-sufficiency-oracle canon against the sufficiency review; and 'the chunk description is dead' against an arm that hard-requires desc_emb and is desc-dominated
